name: rhetorilex
description: Free local academic paraphrase skill and evidence-safe writing workbench.

interface.longDescription: Paraphrase and revise academic, scientific, technical, and Indonesian-English writing with local-first controls, original patterns, protected citations, uncertainty, scope, and scientific claim strength.
defaultPrompt: Paraphrase this paragraph without changing citations, numbers, or claim strength.
Give three cautious ways to state this research gap.
Check whether this paraphrase preserves the evidence.
Compare wording for association, prediction, and causation.
Plan rhetorical moves for a reviewer response.
